user.title: BTicino MyHome - MH201
user.description: Configure the local OpenWebNet connection to the MH201 gateway.

confirm.title: Discovered {model}
confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered a BTicino {model} gateway at {host}. Confirm the OpenWebNet connection settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate BTicino MyHome
reauth_confirm.description: The MH201 gateway at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current OpenWebNet password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BTicino MyHome
reconfigure.description: Update the network connection for this MH201 gateway. Stable serial/UDN identity is checked when discovery data is available.

data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the currently stored password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the gateway. Check address and port.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the OpenWebNet credentials.
error.wrong_gateway: The discovered serial/UDN does not match this configured gateway.
error.already_configured: Another configuration entry already uses this gateway identity.

abort.cannot_connect: The discovered gateway does not provide a usable network address.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The gateway configuration was updated successfully.

data.include_scenarios: Include scenario events observed during the scan

passive_learning.title: Learn BTicino devices
passive_learning.description: Listen to the BUS without sending commands. Use the physical controls you want to identify while listening.

select_learned.title: Discovered devices
select_learned.description: Select the devices to add to the inventory.

manual_device.title: Add device manually
manual_device.description: Register an OpenWebNet endpoint by WHO and WHERE.

remove_device.title: Remove configured devices
remove_device.description: Select inventory endpoints to remove. Their Home Assistant entities and endpoint device entries are removed as well.

error.invalid_device: The selected device type is not valid for the specified WHO.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported device was detected during listening.
abort.no_devices_configured: There are no configured endpoints to remove.
abort.cannot_connect: The integration is not currently loaded or the gateway connection failed.

send_frame.name: Send OpenWebNet frame
send_frame.description: Advanced/debug action that sends one raw OpenWebNet frame through a specific configured MH201 gateway.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: BTicino MyHome configuration entry that owns the target MH201 connection.

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: Raw OpenWebNet frame to send, for example *1*1*21##.

is_status_request.name: Status request
is_status_request.description: Enable only when the raw frame is a status request whose returned data frames should be normalized as state evidence.

send_frame_entry_not_found.message: The selected BTicino MyHome configuration entry was not found.

send_frame_entry_not_loaded.message: The selected BTicino MyHome gateway is not currently loaded.

send_frame_failed.message: Failed to send the OpenWebNet frame: {detail}
